items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: Some of the musicians I played with there was Chink Morton's son, Chink Morton Jr. Eddie Miller played there with me for a while. Who's now playing with Pete Fountain. Yes. And Eddie played alto sax in those days. He wasn't playing tenor. And Al Hesman, banjo player.

ctx.x: And then you went and played in the French Quarter for a while, I guess.

I went to work at a cabaret. It was called the Cabarets in those days. It was called the Valencia Cabaret. It was where the Royal Sinesta Hotel is today, on Bourbon Street. And I worked with various little groups, three-piece groups there, from time to time. Some of the musicians I played with there was Chink Morton's son, Chink Morton Jr. Eddie Miller played there with me for a while. Who's now playing with Pete Fountain. Yes. And Eddie played alto sax in those days. He wasn't playing tenor. And Al Hesman, banjo…
